mapper.select: SELECT c.COMMENT_ID, c.POST_ID, c.USER_ID, u.NAME AS USER_NAME, CASE WHEN cf.FILE_PATH IS NOT NULL AND cf.SAVE_FILE_NM IS NOT NULL THEN cf.FILE_PATH || '/' || cf.SAVE_FILE_NM END AS PROFILE_IMAGE_URL, c.CONTENT, c.PARENT_ID, c.USE_YN, TO_CHAR(c.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DT, TO_CHAR(c.MOD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS MOD_DT, CASE WHEN c.USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IS_OWNER FROM "COMMENT" c LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = c.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CMM_FILE cf ON cf.FILE_ID = u.PROFILE_FILE_ID AND (cf.DEL_YN IS NULL OR cf.DEL_YN = 'N') WHERE c.POST_ID = #{postId} AND c.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY NVL(c.PARENT_ID, c.COMMENT_ID) ASC, c.COMMENT_ID ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_COMMENT_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO "COMMENT" ( COMMENT_ID, POST_ID, USER_ID, CONTENT, PARENT_ID, USE_YN, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{commentId}, #{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{parentId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 'Y', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID FROM "COMMENT" WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
